market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a hawkish Fed pivot with September rate hike increasingly priced in. Energy inflation from diesel highs and Hormuz risk creates a stagflationary undertone. Tech/AI names remain resilient but memory supply constraints may cause rotation. Expect elevated volatility at both ends of the yield curve. Asian tech leads while energy and defense outperform on geopolitical premium.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and memory supercycle support 12-month upside for semiconductors and data infrastructure. Defense spending is structurally elevated. US fiscal trajectory ($40T debt) supports crypto and gold as hedges. Housing affordability crisis persists. Energy transition disrupted by geopolitical supply shocks, extending fossil fuel relevance. China's bank capital injection stabilizes but doesn't resolve structural growth concerns.
